correctness.rationale: For every M>0 the exact C^1 Dulac weight 1/(xy^2) yields divergence (Mx/(x+M)^2-r)/(xy^2), negative a.e. for every r>=1/4. The positive quadrant is convex; a purported periodic Jordan curve bounds a domain there. Green flux equality contradicts the negative integral, including equality r=1/4. At M=1/2 the equilibrium has frequency 1/4, trace crossing -1/2 and normalized G21=-1/4-5i/12, giving first Lyapunov coefficient -1/2 and attracting small cycles on the r<1/4 side. A fresh standalone exact symbolic checker reproduces key identities; the proof itself is analytic.

value.rationale: Existence of local liquidity-profit cycles motivates a global boundary that excludes possible hidden large cycles for all Allee strengths; equality is included. The constructive Hopf witness with M=1/2 makes the cutoff provably sharp uniformly in M, a structural classification relevant to whether oscillations can occur in the exact economic subsystem. The value does not rely on a numerical sweep or on a renamed routine special case.
